a.lede: An Nvidia-backed startup plans to establish a Bitcoin mining operation in space before the year is out.
a.title: ‘We’ll be the first to mine Bitcoin in space’ says Nvidia-backed startup

b.lede: A project claimed to represent 'the first organic neuron Bitcoin miner based on the fly brain' has gone live.
b.title: Google's simulated fruit fly brain 'mines Bitcoin' in web browser proof of concept — FutureBit says real organic neuron miner could have '10x the efficiency of the best silicon 3nm ASICs'
